A windmill commonly seen in Fuuto.
Spins well even in a light breeze.

W's beloved frog-type Memory Gadget.
No combat ability, but it can record audio.

Accel's beloved beetle-type Memory Gadget.
Has scouting functions.

Animal costumes the Imagin often wear
when they go out.

A telescope filled with memories.

A card used by Kamen Rider Zeronos.
One is consumed per transformation.

contract Imagin.

A slipper for delivering retorts, marked "Nande ya nen!"
Makes a great sound when it hits.
Normal attacks may inflict Panic.

A hard-boiled hat with a slightly torn brim.
A great detective's favorite.

W's beloved bat-type Memory Gadget.
Tracks targets and shoots photos and video.
Normal attacks may inflict Blind.

W's beloved stag-beetle-type Memory Gadget.
A phone that can also transform and attack.

Its launched wire helps with climbing up and down.

Collects medals and senses Yummy appearances.

A Candroid that becomes Kujaku Mecha Mode.
Attacks from the air with tail-feather cutters.

A Candroid that becomes Tora Mecha Mode.
Combines with the Ride Vendor into the Tri-Ride Vendor.

A Candroid that becomes Batta Mecha Mode.
Can take photos and relay messages; good for scouting.

A Candroid that becomes Tako Mecha Mode.
Links up to form roads and nets.
Normal attacks become Ice element.

A Candroid that becomes Electric Eel Mecha Mode.
Discharges to pin enemies down.
Normal attacks become Lightning element.

A Candroid that becomes Ptera Mecha Mode.
Its ultrasound can shatter matter.
Normal attacks become Wind element.

A Candroid that becomes Tricera Mecha Mode.
Its horn can knock Candroids to a target spot.

Armor set with extra weapons and thrusters.

A pod for use in emergencies.

Large sunglasses.
Perfect for hiding your identity.

An optional part with built-in weapons
and propellant tanks.

A simple psycommu device that draws out
performance beyond the machine's specs.
A sturdy shield made of E-Carbon.

A heat-resistant air cushion
used when entering the atmosphere.

A versatile weapon that extends freely
and can deploy spear- or flag-shaped beams.
A rose-shaped bit weapon.

A giant iron ball on a beam chain, swung around
and slammed into the enemy.

notes.note: Dev placeholder row (the Japanese is just the item name plus the word for description); translated literally. Same for 6.5-6.35 and 6.56-6.58; 6.27/6.28 are a bare zero plus description.
The Japanese says the stats go down after a set time; the exact effect of the drop is unclear, so rendered as 'goes down'.
The slipper is marked with a Kansai retort; romanized as Nande ya nen.
Tri-Ride Vendor is a guess at the combined vehicle name.
Engraved quote: the Japanese has a 'gives (me/us)' nuance; left neutral.

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: 6.49 (what 'down' means), 7.18 Tri-Ride Vendor, 7.24 engraving. New terms not in glossary: Speed Down, Blind (status, reused from system_061), Memory Gadget, Mecha Mode, Road Sector, Battle Hopper, Psycommu, Tri-Ride Vendor.
